name: ESOMEPRAZOLE 40 MG 14 ASTRA TABLETS
description: Esomeprazole is used to treat the symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), a condition in which acid secreted by the stomach backs up into the esophagus, causing reflux and possible injury to the esophagus (the tube between the throat and stomach). If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
